name: fft_convolution_pipeline
decomposition_rationale: FFT convolution is decomposed into zero-padding calculation, forward FFTs, element-wise complex multiplication, and IFFT with real-part cropping. This matches standard DSP architectures.

atomic_nodes.name: compute_convolving_padding
atomic_nodes.semantic_role: Determines the optimal zero-padding size for linear convolution of two arrays.
postcondition_candidates: all(r >= in1 + in2 - 1 for r, in1, in2 in zip(result, in1_shape, in2_shape))
atomic_nodes.witness_shape_semantics: Returns the shape representing the minimum fast Fourier length required along each dimension.

atomic_nodes.name: multiply_spectral_coefficients
atomic_nodes.semantic_role: Element-wise multiplication of two complex spectra in the frequency domain.
atomic_nodes.witness_shape_semantics: Preserves the shape of the complex input spectra.
atomic_nodes.complexity_reasoning: Linear element-wise complex multiplication of size n.
